newsitem.title: USA: Seagram refuses to pull TV whiskey ads.
newsitem.headline: Seagram refuses to pull TV whiskey ads.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would not pull its television whiskey advertisements in spite of renewed congressional criticism that they are targeted at children.
U.S. Rep. Joseph Kennedy, D-Mass, told reporters that Seagram's television ad campaign featuring a peacock and dogs "is directly targeted at children."

"Beer and wine companies have had unrestricted access to the TV airwaves that supply so much information about the benefits of drinking to the point that now the Budweiser frogs are more readily identifiable to 5th graders in this country than Tony the Tiger or Bugs Bunny and a whole array of cartoon characters," he said.

All but one of greater Boston's local television stations and their local affiliates have pledged not to air the spot, he said, and all but two television stations in New Hampshire have agreed to uphold the ban.
